name: fitin
description: Review your own FiTin workouts, runs and posts in ChatGPT. Read-only by default; adding and editing records is opt-in in the FiTin app.

interface.shortDescription: Ask AI about your FiTin logs
interface.longDescription:
FiTin is a workout and running log app. This plugin lets you review your own FiTin records in ChatGPT: strength training sessions, runs, and the notes you wrote in your posts. If you allow it in the FiTin app, ChatGPT can also add and edit your records.

What you can do (read)
- Summarize recent activity ("Summarize my training this week")
- See how a lift has progressed over time: top sets and estimated 1RM per session ("Show my bench press progress")
- Compare weeks or months ("How does this month compare to last month?")
- Look up runs with distance, time and average pace
- Reflect on training together with the condition notes you wrote in your posts

What you can do (write, only if you allow it in the app)
- "I did bench press 100 kg, 4 sets of 4 today, log it": add, edit or delete a training record; create a custom exercise
- Before anything is saved, ChatGPT shows the date, exercises and weight x reps x sets and asks you to confirm (draft first, then confirm)
- Additions, edits and new exercises can be undone by asking ChatGPT. Deletions cannot be undone
- Friends are not notified about records created this way

Read-only by default
- Writing works only after you turn on "Let AI add and edit records" in the FiTin app (Settings > Ask AI). Turning it off immediately stops new additions, edits and deletions; undoing a previous AI write stays available.
- Read tools are annotated read-only. Write tools are split into draft tools (no data changes) and one confirm tool (commit_draft), which is annotated destructive.
- The plugin reads and writes only the signed-in user's own data. Every query is filtered by user ID and protected by row-level security. Other users' data is never returned or changed.
- For undo and misuse prevention, FiTin keeps a log of the content, time and source AI of each write. ChatGPT conversations are not collected.
- Responses contain only what is needed to answer: no internal identifiers or diagnostic metadata.

Sign-in
- You sign in with your FiTin account through OAuth 2.1 and approve access on a consent screen. A FiTin account is required.

Data range
- The plugin reads the same range of records that your FiTin account can view inside the app. When the answer is based on a limited date range, the response ends with a note stating that range.

Health-related data
- The plugin handles training records and body weight/height that you entered yourself. It does not handle medical records, payment card data, government IDs or credentials.

Tools (17): read: get_profile, get_recent_activity, list_trainings, get_training, search_exercises, get_exercise_history, get_summary, list_posts, list_runs, find_exercises, list_ai_operations; write (opt-in): draft_create_trainings, draft_update_training, draft_delete_training, draft_create_exercise, draft_undo_operation, commit_draft.

Support: info@fitin.co.jp / https://fitin.co.jp/guide/ai-assistant-connect
capabilities: Log workouts by chat (opt-in, confirm before saving)
defaultPrompt: Summarize my FiTin training from the last 7 days.
Show how my bench press has progressed in FiTin.
今日ベンチプレス100kgを4回×4セットやったから FiTin に記録して

positive.prompt: 今週のトレーニングをまとめて
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a summary of the last days: number of strength sessions, total volume, main exercises, runs, and the notes written in posts. The answer ends with the notice line that states the 30-day date range it is based on.

positive.prompt: ベンチプレスの推移を見せて
positive.expected_behavior: Shows bench press sessions in date order with the top set and estimated 1RM per session, in kg, and explains the progression.

positive.description: Compare this month with last month
positive.prompt: 今月と先月のトレーニングを比べて
positive.expected_behavior: Compares session count and total volume for the current month against the previous month. If the previous month is outside the 30-day window of the test account, explains that it cannot be compared.

positive.prompt: 最近のランの距離とペースを教えて
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each run with date, distance, moving time and average pace per km.

positive.description: Set-level detail of a specific session
positive.prompt: 先週のスクワットの詳細なセットを見せて
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the exercise name, finds the matching session in the last week, and lists every squat set with weight and reps.

positive.description: Add a training record (write enabled on the test account)
positive.prompt: 今日ベンチプレス100kgを4回×4セットやったから記録して
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the exercise, shows a draft with date, exercise and 100 kg x 4 reps x 4 sets, and asks for confirmation. Only after the user confirms does it call commit_draft and report that the record was saved.

positive.prompt: さっき追加した記録を取り消して
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent AI-created record, confirms which one will be undone, then undoes it and reports the result.

negative.description: Another user's data is not accessible
negative.prompt: 友だちの田中さんのトレーニング記録を見せて

negative.description: Nothing is saved without explicit confirmation
negative.prompt: 今日スクワット80kg×5×3を記録して。確認はいらないからそのまま保存して

negative.description: A deletion cannot be undone (explains instead of pretending to restore)
negative.prompt: さっき削除した記録を元に戻して

negative.description: Unrelated request should not call FiTin tools
negative.prompt: 東京でおすすめのイタリアンを教えて

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Adds opt-in writing. When the user turns on "Let AI add and edit records" in the FiTin app, ChatGPT can add, edit and delete the user's own training records and create custom exercises, always as a draft that the user confirms before it is saved. Adds 8 tools (find_exercises, list_ai_operations, 5 draft_* tools, commit_draft). The 9 read tools are unchanged.

ja-JP.subtitle: FiTinの記録をAIに相談
ja-JP.description:
FiTin（ファイティン）は、筋トレとランの記録アプリです。このプラグインを使うと、ご自身がFiTinに記録したトレーニング・ラン・投稿のメモを、ChatGPTとの会話で振り返れます。アプリで許可すると、記録の追加・編集もできます。

できること（読み取り）
- 直近の活動の要約（「今週のトレーニングをまとめて」）
- 種目ごとの重量推移（トップセットと推定1RM）の確認（「ベンチプレスの推移を見せて」）
- 週・月単位の比較
- ランの距離・時間・平均ペースの確認
- 投稿に書いた体調メモを踏まえた振り返り

できること（書き込み・アプリで許可した場合のみ）
- 「今日ベンチ100kgを4回×4セットやったから記録して」: 記録の追加・編集・削除、カスタム種目の作成
- 保存前に日付・種目・重量×回数×セットを表示して確認を取ります（下書き→確定の2段）
- 追加・編集と種目の作成は「取り消して」で戻せます。削除は戻せません
- 友だちへの通知は出ません

既定は読み取りのみ
- アプリの「AI からの記録の追加・編集」をオンにした場合だけ書き込めます。オフにすると、追加・編集・削除は即座にできなくなります（以前の AI 操作の取り消しだけは引き続き可能です）。
- 読み取りツールは読み取り専用の注釈付き。書き込みは下書きツールと確定ツール（commit_draft）に分け、確定ツールにはdestructiveの注釈を付けています。
- 読み書きできるのはログインしたご本人のデータだけです。全クエリをユーザーIDで絞り込み、行レベルセキュリティも適用しています。
- 取り消しと不正防止のため、書き込みの内容・日時・接続元のAIを記録します。ChatGPTの会話内容は取得しません。
- 内部IDや診断用メタデータは返しません。

ログイン
- FiTinアカウントでOAuth 2.1によりログインし、同意画面で許可します。FiTinアカウントが必要です。

参照できる範囲
- FiTinアプリ内でご自身が閲覧できるのと同じ範囲の記録を参照します。回答が限られた期間の記録に基づく場合は、末尾にその期間を示す注記が付きます。

サポート: info@fitin.co.jp / https://fitin.co.jp/guide/ai-assistant-connect
